The Trench Funnel framework synthesizes six domains—biophysical, cognitive, dfs, environmental, market, and on-field—into a coherent causal chain. Air density and wind impact ballistics, while injury availability modifies unit rotations and leverage. Tracking data refines player efficiency estimates. Market priors (Kalshi, book lines) are cross-validated for reliability. Cognitive biases from news flow and DFS ownership are factored through attention pressure. The system operates under dual assumptions: that environmental and injury data are stable and that tracking data is accurate. Failure modes include divergent Kalshi-book priors (>3 pts), weather shifts beyond thresholds, or invalid tracking data. Each primitive maps to a Layer-2 kernel for state transition modeling and Bayesian updating.
